node.title: Annex 01J — Ecosystem Signalling: Selective Disclosure, Distributed Opportunity and Choreographed Repositioning
node.summary: Contenido de la fuente: 1. Purpose and architectural boundary · 2. Local state and selective projection · 3. Four signal classes that must remain distinct.

relations: Selective, source-qualified handoffs could let one field fact support several receivers without exposing unnecessary information or substituting one receiver’s determination for another’s.
Propuesta posterior al caso; no se atribuye al sistema histórico la implementación del protocolo de señalización.
